newsitem.title: USA: Mid Ocean Q2 premium growth up on Brockbank.
newsitem.headline: Mid Ocean Q2 premium growth up on Brockbank.

text.p: Mid Ocean Ltd said Friday that premiums written rose sharply in the second quarter, helped by a substantial contribution from the Brockbank Group at Lloyd's.
Gross written premiums rose 27 percent to $137.9 million, with $95.4 million coming from Brockbank.
Mid Ocean today reported second quarter operating earnings of $1.74 a share, beating the First Call consensus estimate of $1.43.
Mid Ocean shares were up one point at 50-3/8 after posting strong gains in recent days ahead of the earnings announcement.
Mid Ocean Chief Executive Michael Butt said the results were achieved despite modestly unfavorable comparisons to the prior year in the areas of foreign exchange and investment losses.
"The strong profitability also stems from a lack of loss activity and the continuing positive development of our loss reserves," he said.
Butt said the company continues to exert underwriting discipline, which has caused it to reduce business written in those areas which it perceives to be inadequately rated.
In addition, he said, Mid Ocean has initiated the process agreed to with Brockbank shareholders in December 1995, which is expected to culminate in a tender offer for the shares of Brockbank.
